newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close up led by Electricidad.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close up led by Electricidad.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed up in moderate trade, led by bellwether utility Electricidad de Caracas, but brokers said the market's rise was unlikely to be sustained.
"Most local investors aren't paying attention to the bolsa over the Easter holidays and foreign players are mostly neutral, sitting and waiting, at the moment," said Financorp broker Miguel Ortiz.
The market's 19-share index closed up 0.96 percent at 6,314.32 points, according to preliminary figures from the exchange.
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, rose 1.0 percent to close at 96.09 points.
Trade volume was boosted to nearly 12 million shares, worth 4.6 billion bolivars ($9.6 million), as four million shares in Electricidad de Caracas cross-traded.
Electricidad closed up 4.25 bolivars at 513.00 bolivars.
